decision: Approved anatomy-first projection of exactly 22 bean-pod classes and two whole lobster-tail classes; not an inference from lost organism ancestry.

native_evidence.authority: sources.foodon.json_context and sources.foodon.owl_context: complete selected declarations, definitions, annotations, restrictions, equivalent expressions, incident assertions and descendant scope
native_evidence.rationale: Pods are multicellular fruit/pod structures, not whole plants. The two whole-tail classes describe an anatomical tail; the two tail-meat controls have a separate culinary meaning. This finite primary projection preserves native IDs and all evidence, does not mint taxon identity, and changes no hierarchy assertions.

separate_kernel_policy: foodon_kernel_quarantine.json; its exact 22 Food categories and one parent quarantine are unchanged
